messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync — we need alignment on the new 'Connectors' packaging for ISV/tooling (LangChain + LlamaIndex + Gateway adapters) and the joint marketplace launch. Target announcement week Mar 15. High level asks: sample notebooks, adapter spec, marketplace package, HW perf bake-off results.

Dan (eng): I can draft the gateway adapter spec by EOD. Question: do we include quantized model variants in the initial package or ship them as follow-ups?

Lisa (product): Include at least one quantized default + note about variants. Also need rollback playbook for Dedicated customers.

Simon (devex): Demo checklist: small Flask demo + LangChain quickstart + step-by-step README. I'll own sample app + README.

Alex (marketing): We'll need: 1-pager, partner co-blog, assets (logos/screens), and a 60s demo script. Can we commit assets by Mar 8?

Maya (partnerships): Mar 8 for marketing assets works. HW partners: @hw-bench-bot will run the perf suite next Tue — please ensure gateway + quantized 4-bit variants are benchable.

hw-bench-bot: perf-suite queued: bench_id=cntr-v1-1719998888, expected_run=2026-03-10, ETA 48h.

Dan (eng): For packaging, propose this manifest snippet to standardize installs:
```
connector:
  name: redwood-orch-connector
  adapters: [langchain, llamaindex, gateway]
  models: [rwi-knl-2b-quant, rwi-lrg-8b]
  marketplace_meta: {private_only: false}
```

Maya (partnerships): Nice. Legal/compliance signoff needed for a joint announcement — @Lisa can you loop in legal? Also confirm marketplace supports private-only flag for enterprise customers.

Lisa (product): On it. Marketplace listing flow requires a security scan and privacy checklist — I'll start the intake today. Might need a week for review.

Simon (devex): We'll add a CI smoke test: `make smoke-integration LANGCHAIN=1 GATEWAY=1` and a small e2e using the sample notebook.

Alex (marketing): Timeline proposal: marketing draft by Mar 5, partner review by Mar 8, publish Mar 15. Need signoffs by Mar 12 for final assets.

Maya (partnerships): Action items recap: Dan — adapter spec (EOD); Simon — sample app + smoke tests (Mar 4); Alex — assets + blog draft (Mar 5); Lisa — legal/compliance intake (Mar 6); hw-bench-bot — perf run results (Mar 10). I'll compile partner FAQ and send to partners after we have bench numbers.

Dan (eng): noted. Any objections to announcing in marketplaces (cloud marketplaces) simultaneously with our blog?

Lisa (product): Marketplace pre-approval might be the gating item. If we prioritize the security scan, simultaneous listing is possible but tight for Mar 15. Recommend contingency plan: publish blog + partner announcement first, marketplace tile the following week if needed.

Maya (partnerships): Good call — contingency ACK. Quick question: who owns the LangChain contact?

Simon (devex): I'll reach out to Sarah at LangChain (I have a contact). Will cc partners and update here after initial touch.

Alex (marketing): Can we schedule a dry-run demo on Mar 12? 30 mins — run through sample app + 60s script.

Maya (partnerships): Scheduled — invite incoming. :calendar: :rocket:

Dan (eng): thumbs up :+1:

deploy-bot: bench cntr-v1-1719998888 started.

Maya (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll drop links to the adapter spec draft, sample app repo, and the demo invite in this thread once available. Please flag blockers early. :handshake:
